We need to produce correct JSON with real template IDs. Must search for each step. Let's search for sulfonamide formation template.


<thought>To build a valid 6‑step retrosynthetic route I will locate appropriate retrosynthetic templates from the catalog for each disconnection described in the guide. I will search for templates that (1) break a sulfonamide into a sulfonyl chloride and an amine, (2) break a carbamate into an alcohol and an acyl chloride, (3) break a tertiary amine into a secondary amine and an alkyl halide (N‑alkylation), (4) open the flavanone ring to a chalcone (intramolecular Michael), (5) form a chalcone from an acetophenone and a benzaldehyde, and (6) prepare a fluorophenyl‑sulfonyl chloride from fluorobenzene. After obtaining the template IDs I will assemble the route in the required JSON format.
